items.question: What is the minimum capital required for an insurance company licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE to operate in the UAE?
items.fact: CBUAE minimum capital for insurance companies is AED 100 million

items.question: What is the minimum paid-up capital required to register as an insurance agent in the UAE with the Central Bank of the UAE?
items.gold: A paid-up capital of at least AED 500,000.
items.fact: Insurance agent registration requires paid-up capital of at least AED 500,000
